name: Switchyard
description: An invented AI gateway, laid out as a bold poster catalogue of notched panels
intent: A catalogue that is a poster. Fifty-three inline SVGs and thirty-four controls on one page, with the notch cut into every panel doing the work a border would usually do, which is why the page reads as printed rather than assembled.

source.title: Notched Panel Catalog Page
source.author: Ray Velez
source.changed: New brand, copy and figures, and a retuned palette
